notes: at all is given to the cognate infinitive absolute under rule 56, headed on all as the lexeme-bearing word of the two-word adverbial.
The waw before lu is unrendered; the ASV opens the wish with would that, which is the optative particle's own formula (rules 17, 30).
over in brought this people over the Jordan is read as the phrasal particle of the Hiphil he'evir rather than as the second object marker's rendering under rule 16; the verb's own lexeme licenses it.
